source_signature.notes: Batch 4H skill 3/4 (four-skill exception). Scope Operator-derived. The multi-surface dry-friction MACHINE specialization off the signed coulomb_friction_impending: a wedge driven by P raises/holds a load through contact on inclined and supporting faces, with friction on each contact. Owns the multi-body wedge analysis; single-surface friction FBDs (friction_fbd_normal_force, friction_equilibrium_sliding, dry_friction_static_kinetic) are the signed parallel and are cited, not re-taught; screw_friction is the sibling unwrapped-wedge and is NOT solved here; belt, rolling resistance, bearing, and stress are excluded. FRICTION DISTINCTION (directive-mandated) BITES: the premise is IMPENDING motion, so |F| = mu_s N holds AT THE LIMIT on each impending surface - stated as a limit condition, not the reflexive F = muN in every statics problem - and friction DIRECTION opposes each surface's OWN impending relative motion, shown to DIFFER by face (incline: friction on the load acts DOWN the face as the load rises relative to the wedge; floor: friction on the wedge acts LEFT as the wedge slides right) rather than uniformly opposing P. Worked example Operator-re-derived from the on-disk prompt (source-locked): W=650 N block against a smooth vertical wall and on a wedge face at alpha from the HORIZONTAL with sin alpha = 3/5, cos alpha = 4/5; mu_s = 0.25 on the incline and the floor; P horizontal, impending raise. Load body first: SigmaFy N1 cos a - F1 sin a - W = 0 -> N1(0.8 - 0.15) = 650 -> N1 = 1000 N, F1 = 250 N; SigmaFx -> Nw = 600 + 200 = 800 N. Wedge: SigmaFy Ng = N1 cos a - F1 sin a = 800 - 150 = 650 N, Fg = 162.5 N; SigmaFx P = Fg + N1 sin a + F1 cos a = 162.5 + 600 + 200 = 962.5 N. TRIG-RESOLUTION CROSS-CHECK APPLIED (the standing rule adopted from the Batch 4G finding) and PASSED: angle reference stated explicitly as alpha FROM THE HORIZONTAL; N1 -> (600, 800) with 600^2 + 800^2 = 1000^2; F1 down-incline -> (200, -150) with 200^2 + 150^2 = 250^2; larger leg on the axis adjacent to the smaller angle; no memorized cos->x. FOUR-signal mapping: axis_confusion at step 4 (resolving N and F on the INCLINED face - wrong alpha reference or swapping along-face vs normal-to-face components; a genuine axis-assignment earn), sign_or_placement_error at step 3 (per-surface friction DIRECTION - the crux the skill measures), solution_sequencing_error at step 5 (GENUINELY EARNED: the wedge equilibrium contains N1 and F1 as unknowns that only the load-body solve supplies, so attempting the wedge first strands them - the wedge alone is underdetermined; evidence-gated by the authored solve-load-first step; same class as frame_machine_equilibrium's member coupling and shear_moment_diagram_construction's construction order), unclassified at step 7 (boundary fallback: reflexive muN without the impending premise, missing friction decision, or reaching into screw/belt/rolling/bearing/stress). The unclassified mapping was ADDED in correction lane PHASE-D-WEDGE-FRICTION-CORRECTION-001 after Operator review found the boundary fallback omitted while the three sharp signals were all correctly earned; the correction added exactly one mapping entry with the prior three byte-identical and the derivation untouched. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family).
